questions.text: What is the world ultimately made of?
questions.help: The oldest split in the field: materialism, dualism, idealism and the views in between.

options.label: Matter, but minds are real in their own right, not just a way of describing brains.

options.label: Mind. The physical world is how mind appears.
options.agree: You both think mind comes first
